question: What is the bridge on open ground, over all marks, and is any single mark's value resolvable?

inputs.role: per-mark bridge table from run_bridge_wide.py; bridge_mm is z_delivered - z_ours, both on NAVD88(GEOID03)

params.name: covers
params.why: open ground only; the validation gate reproduces the shipped grid to +1.7 mm on the open mark and -30.5 mm on the vegetated one

params.name: estimator
params.value: 'mean and median, both reported, neither chosen'
params.why: the per-mark values are heavy-tailed, so a mean alone would be a claim about the tails; nothing is trimmed or filtered

columns.value_mm: its value in mm, or a count where the name says count

headline: bridge -4.04 +/- 11.12 mm over 29 open marks
